message: Astra: Within Ya na’s “conversation with Alex,” what can a reader actually infer about the data rather than the danger? Which missing detail deserves attention, and what would show that it changes the investigation? Why would thinking further be worth its time compared with attempting a passage now, and what uncertainty could make that attempt premature? Could you briefly identify your finding from the draft, your uncertainty, and your chosen next intention in English, then carry out that choice?
